title: Delicious Weeknight Pregnancy Menus: 5 Cook-Once Recipes
excerpt: Five flavorful recipes for busy evenings — soup, stir-fry, egg dishes and yogurt parfaits — balanced for protein, fiber and calcium.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating a balanced and nutritious diet is crucial to ensure the health of both mother and baby. However, with a busy schedule, preparing a delicious and healthy meal can be a challenge. In this article, we will introduce 5 cook-once recipes that can help pregnant women have a nutritious and delicious dinner.

## Nutrient Analysis
The recipes below are chosen to provide a balanced amount of protein, fiber, and calcium, essential nutrients for the health of both mother and baby. According to the [WHO](https://www.who.int/tools/elena/interventions/nutrition-counselling-pregnancy), nutrition counseling during pregnancy is crucial to ensure the health of both mother and baby.

## 5 Cook-Once Recipes
### 1. Chicken and Vegetable Soup
Chicken and vegetable soup is a delicious and nutritious meal that provides a large amount of protein and fiber. To cook chicken and vegetable soup, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 2 carrots
- 2 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar

Cook the chicken and vegetable soup for about 30 minutes, then add the vegetables and cook for an additional 10 minutes.

### 2. Chicken and Vegetable Stir-Fry
Chicken and vegetable stir-fry is a great option for dinner, providing a large amount of protein and fiber. To cook chicken and vegetable stir-fry, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 2 carrots
- 2 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar

Stir-fry the chicken and vegetables for about 10 minutes, then add a little water and cook for an additional 5 minutes.

### 3. Fried Eggs with Vegetables
Fried eggs with vegetables are a great option for dinner, providing a large amount of protein and fiber. To cook fried eggs with vegetables, you need:
- 2 eggs
- 1 carrot
- 1 potato
- 1 onion
- 1 clove of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar

Cook the fried eggs for about 5 minutes, then add the vegetables and cook for an additional 2 minutes.

### 4. Yogurt Parfait with Fruit
Yogurt parfait with fruit is a great option for dinner, providing a large amount of calcium and fiber. To cook yogurt parfait, you need:
- 1 cup of yogurt
- 1 cup of fruit
- 1 teaspoon of honey

Mix the yogurt and fruit in a bowl, then add a little honey and mix well.

### 5. Chicken and Vegetable Fried Rice
Chicken and vegetable fried rice is a great option for dinner, providing a large amount of protein and fiber. To cook chicken and vegetable fried rice, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 2 carrots
- 2 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar

Cook the chicken and vegetable fried rice for about 30 minutes, then add the vegetables and cook for an additional 10 minutes.

## Practical Tips
To ensure food safety, remember to [cook food thoroughly](https://www.cdc.gov/food-safety/people-at-risk/pregnant-women.html) before eating. Additionally, choose fresh and clean food to ensure quality.

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about nutrition during pregnancy, [seek help](/support) from healthcare professionals.
